rules.title: OpenTelemetry
rules.text: Instrument with OpenTelemetry for traces and metrics rather than vendor-specific SDKs.

rules.title: Health endpoints
rules.text: Expose liveness and readiness endpoints that reflect real dependencies.

rules.title: Golden signals
rules.text: Track latency, traffic, errors and saturation for every service.

rules.title: Bound metric cardinality
rules.text: Never use unbounded values such as user IDs or URLs as metric labels.

rules.title: Propagate trace context
rules.text: Propagate trace and correlation context across service calls and background jobs.

rules.title: Alert on symptoms
rules.text: Alert on user-visible symptoms and SLO burn rather than on every internal cause.

rules.title: Report unexpected errors
rules.text: Send unexpected errors to the error tracker with context, and do not report expected validation failures.

rules.title: Review metric changes
rules.text: Review metric changes for registration, duplicate names, label cardinality and the effect of renames on dashboards and alerts.
